text:
alex_pm: Quick sync - proposing a cutover handshake for private deployments that minimizes customer downtime and gives NetOps control over networking changes. TL;DR: staged operator-based rollout + optional offline installer, explicit IP-preserve mode, and a lightweight migration operator for KV cache migration.

Tess: +1 to staged approach. can you share the rough phases?

alex_pm: Phase 0: Planning & customer readiness checklist. Phase 1: Dry-run on staging (operator + offline installer). Phase 2: Canary customers (single-tenant). Phase 3: Full migration with rollback window.

mike_field: Field note - customers want IP preservation and minimal firewall churn. They hate changing NATs during cutover. Need clear ip-preserve docs and a config flag.

tess_eng: For operator flow we can support `ip_preserve: true` in the Tenant CR. That avoids reassigning service IPs during shim rollout. Small caveat: swap requires same node count for graceful handoff.

ranjit_security: We need KMS/HSM key handoff documented. Private deploys with customer-managed KMS require an explicit key-rotation plan during upgrade. Also audit log retention shouldn't reset.

lee_sre: Add monitoring hooks to detect KV cache mis-sync and token mismatch. We'll add a `migration-check` probe that returns non-200 if any prefix is missing. That can gate rollout.

alex_pm: Great — proposed launch criteria: 1) Installer + operator validated on staging, 2) ip_preserve validated with 2 customers, 3) KMS handoff runbook + checklist, 4) migration-check probe autopasses for 48h on canaries, 5) rollback plan tested. Agree?

mike_field: Sounds good. Suggest 1 extra acceptance: a customer-facing rollback comms template and post-mortem template. Field teams will need those.

tess_eng: Implementation notes: operator will have a `migrationMode` enum: `shadow`, `cutover`, `rollback`. Shadow streams traffic to new runtime but continues writing to old. Cutover flips reads. Rollback reverts routes.

alex_pm: Example config snippet for validators we can share with customers:

```
apiVersion: redwood.io/v1
kind: Tenant
metadata:
  name: acme
spec:
  ip_preserve: true
  migrationMode: shadow
  kmsProvider: customer-kms
```

lee_sre: Nice. Also ensure deploy-bot posts a summary to #release-war-room when canary flips.

deploy-bot: plan-schedule created for canary window 2025-03-12 02:00-06:00 UTC. Notifying stakeholders. :bell:

ranjit_security: One more — include a security signoff step for airgapped installs: confirm image provenance and a verified checksum file.

alex_pm: I'll update the PRD with these criteria + add the field comms templates. Action items: Tess - prototype migration-check probe (owner). Lee - add deploy-bot hook for canary flips. Mike - line up 2 canary customers. Ranjit - write KMS airgap checklist. I'll draft comms.

tess_eng: On it, will ping when probe PR is ready.

mike_field: I'll reach out to two existing customers this afternoon.

ranjit_security: I'll draft checklist and post in this thread by EOD.

alex_pm: Thanks all. Plan to reconvene after probe PR + canary confirmations. :calendar:
